title: Litefleet: one bounded read, gateway to SQLite
authoredBy: Claude Opus 5.5, playing the pipeline's AI-mapping step by hand (POC)

code.presentation: tabs expanded to 4 spaces; no other change

story: Follow one tenant read along the C4 dynamic view query-flow (cache-hit path), then step into the node hop (relationship sql-tenant) and show the real Engine.Query guards and row caps as the request reaches them.

scenes.caption: A tenant app sends a read: SQL plus a bearer API key.

narration.text: A tenant app sends a read: SQL plus a bearer API key.

scenes.caption: Route cache hit: steps 3-5 (control plane, registry) are skipped.

narration.text: Route cache hit. Steps three to five, the control plane and the registry, are skipped.

scenes.caption: The gateway posts the query and the route's epoch (X-Epoch) to the owning node.

narration.text: The gateway posts the query and the route's epoch, X-Epoch, to the owning node.

scenes.caption: Inside the node: Engine.Query, exec.go at release-it/v1-hardened.

narration.text: Inside the node: Engine dot Query, in exec dot go, at release-it v1 hardened.

scenes.caption: Only a single read statement is accepted here; writes go to execute.

narration.text: Only a single read statement is accepted here; writes go to execute.

scenes.caption: admit: the node serves only requests routed with the database's current epoch.

narration.text: Admit: the node serves only requests routed with the database's current epoch.

scenes.caption: acquire takes a read lane: the per-database bulkhead (2 readers at once).

narration.text: Acquire takes a read lane: the per-database bulkhead, two readers at once.

scenes.caption: Rows are scanned from the tenant's SQLite file and streamed as they arrive.

narration.text: Rows are scanned from the tenant's SQLite file and streamed as they arrive.

scenes.caption: Capped at MaxRows (1000) or MaxBytes (1 MiB): the answer says truncated.

narration.text: Capped at Max Rows, one thousand, or Max Bytes, one mebibyte: the answer says truncated.

scenes.caption: Capped rows stream back through gateway and HAProxy to the tenant.

narration.text: Capped rows stream back through gateway and H-A-Proxy to the tenant.

narration.note: Each scene.narration.text is the spoken form of scene.caption (edits for speakability only, listed in NOTES.md). scripts/narrate.mjs voices each line once into narration/<scene>.mp3 + .alignment.json, then derives narration/timeline.json: scene duration = max(storyboard duration, leadIn + last character end + tail), frame-rounded, and each cue = leadIn + start of its anchor phrase. The scene reads durations and cue times only from timeline.json.
